text: cohort node stores: - status — per-row integer vector. 0L = included; otherwise absolute log step index excluded row. - log_entries — full exclusion log, including inherited prefix copied parent branch time. steps come . - branched_at_log_len — parent’s log length branch = boundary inherited prefix cohort’s steps. (Absolute.) - branched_at_status — parent’s status snapshot branch time. - replay_cursor — far warm replay re-confirmed node’s log. Initialised load branched_at_log_len. Absolute index. - frozen — set child branches artifact attached; blocks exclude_and_track (cold path ). Key tension bugs live : absolute log index (counts inherited prefix) vs branch-local count (steps ). replay_cursor status step numbers absolute; code treats cursor branch-local.

what: Finding 3 — non-logical predicate corrupts provenance [status: ✅ understand / ✅ fixed / ✅ testthat]
title: PROJECT.md — CohortPipeline adversarial-review fixes
text: : exclude_and_track() ~L421-427. Problem: mask length-checked, NA→FALSE, .logical(mask). non-logical predicate ("sex", "age") sails . matters: .logical("F")→FALSE, .logical(40)→TRUE. Numeric predicate silently excluded 2/3 rows; character predicate logged phantom exclusion. audit trail (whole point package) corrupted. Fix: require .logical(mask) (reject matrices/non-atomic ) coercion; error reason-tagged message style. Edge cases: logical NA still → FALSE (documented). Tests: character, numeric, factor, matrix predicate results.

what: Finding 1 — stale cached child exclusion retained on divergence [status: 🟡 understand (root-cause ✓, fix walkthrough deferred) / ✅ fixed / ✅ testthat]
title: PROJECT.md — CohortPipeline adversarial-review fixes
text: : .invalidate_from() L970-999, called exclude_and_track(). Problem: caller passes absolute cursor; .invalidate_from treats branch-local (keep_len <- branched_at_log_len + own_cursor). non-root cohort double-counts prefix → truncation -removes (misses entirely), changed -step leaves stale entry place appends new one. root worked: root’s branched_at_log_len == 0, absolute == local. Fix: make .invalidate_from cursor absolute: keep_len <- cursor; replay entries branched_at_log_len+1 .. cursor; replay_cursor <- cursor. Edge cases: test non-root cohort changing later exclusion.

what: Finding 2 — reordered branch point silently keeps stale snapshot [status: 🟡 understand (walkthrough deferred) / ✅ fixed / ✅ testthat]
title: PROJECT.md — CohortPipeline adversarial-review fixes
text: : new_cohort() replay early-return L312-323. Problem: child already exists matching parent, returns without checking parent replay position child branched. Moving new_cohort() parent exclusion keeps old post-exclusion snapshot. script run cold errors (freeze rule); warm replay silently succeeds wrong data. Fix: -parent replay, require parent$replay_cursor == existing$branched_at_log_len; otherwise error pointing $invalidate() (correct partial rebuild impossible — parent’s intermediate status never stored). Edge cases: benign sibling reorder (branch point) must trip .

what: How the cache decides what to recompute
title: Cohort construction with provenance
text: worked example already uses cache_file .exit(cp$save()). second run script, every operation checked cached log: match advances replay cursor work done. mismatch truncates log point, drops downstream artifacts, cascades descendant cohorts whose inherited prefix now stale, recomputes changed. Labels presentation, part cache key, re-issuing new_cohort("adults_female", = "root", label = "Adult women") updates label without invalidating anything. set_artifact, prefer 3-argument signature function(dt, sib, argset): data dependencies argset participate cache key, changing argset = list(washout = 84L) washout = 90L triggers recompute. 2-argument form function(dt, sib) still works won’t catch closure-captured changes. cache key uses body(fn) literally; fn calls helper change, cache detect . Either include version tag argset, call cp$invalidate(cohort) drop cohort force recompute.

title: Version 2026.8.3
text: Documentation . behaviour changed, runtime message, warning error string changed. index.md now listed .Rbuildignore, pkgdown home page body longer ships source tarball. file R CMD   check recognises, ---cran raised “Non-standard file/directory found top level: ‘index.md’” every run. ?CohortPipeline now carries \seealso naming vignette("cohort") saying vignette works : branching, cached artifacts, schemas CONSORT diagrams.

title: Version 2026.7.27
text: $list_artifacts() now returns character(0) cohort artifacts. previously returned NULL, broke documented “character vector” contract caller indexing result. $list_cohorts() empty pipeline now returns zero-row data.table carrying eight documented columns (name, parent, n_total, n_included, n_excluded, n_own_steps, n_artifacts, frozen). previously returned zero-row, zero-column table, column access empty pipeline failed. matches $consort(), already returned typed empty table.

title: Version 2026.6.23
text: exclude_and_track() now errors predicate evaluates non-logical result (character, numeric, factor, logical matrix) instead silently coercing .logical(). numeric predicate previously excluded every non-zero row character predicate logged phantom exclusion, corrupting audit trail. documented contract – predicates return TRUE/FALSE, NA means keep – now enforced. Warm-cache replay: changing non-root cohort’s later exclusion longer retains stale step. .invalidate_from() treated cursor branch-local count caller passed absolute log index, double-counting inherited prefix truncation -removed. Root cohorts unaffected (zero prefix). Warm-cache replay: moving $new_cohort() parent exclusion (order errors cold run via freeze rule) now errors instead silently reusing child’s stale post-exclusion snapshot. parent’s replay position checked child’s branch point; mismatch directed $invalidate() (delete cache).

text: CohortPipeline$new() accepts cache_file = argument. file exists, pipeline restored operations replay cached log; matching operations -ops (cache hits), divergent operations recompute affected cohort descendants. cp$save() writes current state cache file. set_artifact() gains argset parameter accepts new 3-argument fn signature function(dt, sib, argset). cache key (name, , body(fn), argset). legacy function(dt, sib) signature still accepted (compat shim). title: Version 2026.5.10
text: cohort becomes frozen first time another cohort branches , first time artifact set . freezing, $exclude_and_track() cohort errors. rule guarantees cohort’s name maps exactly one definition forever cached artifacts stay consistent included rows produced . Multi-way forks unaffected.

title: Version 2026.5.10
text: Shared base table + per-branch integer index included rows. Branching never copies data values. Integer status codes (per branch) replace -band string status columns. user’s data table never mutated. Exclusion logs accumulate list materialize read, avoiding quadratic rbind growth. $get_included() always returns independent copy. $get_everyone() reconstructs per-branch full view (rows + .cohort_status column) returned object meaningful branch tree. $plot() defaults plotting every cohort regardless freeze state, unfrozen leaf cohorts (typical analytic endpoint) always shown. CONSORT rendering now implemented directly grid instead via consort package. Arrows now terminate exactly side-box edges (consort rendering placed inside box), multi-panel layouts top-align panel content. consort package dropped Imports.
